subject: Pilot vendor onboarding: one-off no-PO request (Atlas Insights)
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire@atlasinsights.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasinsights.com, accounting@atlasinsights.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-off no-PO onboarding for 3-week pilot

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team is excited to run a short 3-week pilot of Redwood for our internal analytics workflows. Our procurement team prefers standard processes, but given the pilot size (estimated $1.2k total) we were hoping to request a temporary no-PO onboarding so we can get started quickly while procurement completes the full vendor review.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood supports an invoice-only onboarding for small pilots?
- What evidence you need from us (W-9, insurance, basic SLA acknowledgement)?
- Any expiry on a one-off waiver (we'd prefer it to cover this pilot only).

Attaching a short vendor intake form and a proposed SOW for the pilot.

Appreciate a quick path — our engineers are ready to start next Monday.

Best,
Claire
Claire Hsu
Vendor Ops, Atlas Insights
attachments: atlas-intake-form.pdf (application/pdf); pilot-sow.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire@atlasinsights.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off no-PO onboarding for 3-week pilot

Claire —

Thanks for the SOW and intake form. Short answers up front: yes, we can support an invoice-only path for small pilots, but there are a couple of required items procurement needs to have on file before we enable billing without a PO.

Request for you: please complete the attached evidence checklist (I populated a few fields based on the intake form) and return the W-9 if applicable. Once procurement confirms risk tiering and we get accounting sign-off, we can offer a one-off no-PO addendum that specifically covers the pilot period.

I'll loop in David in Procurement for formal sign-off and Marissa for any commercial terms that need a short addendum. Typically the waiver covers a fixed date range and a cap amount; we include an automatic expiration tied to pilot end.

Next steps:
- Claire: return completed atlas-evidence-checklist.pdf + W-9 (if US entity) by Wed EOD
- Kimberly: route to Procurement (David) for risk tier review
- Marissa: prepare a short addendum and invoice instructions

If you want to expedite, I can provision a trial seat that doesn't require billing so engineers can test while paperwork completes.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: atlas-evidence-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Claire Hsu <claire@atlasinsights.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasinsights.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 08:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off no-PO onboarding for 3-week pilot

Hi Kimberly,

Attached the completed checklist and W-9. We confirmed with our accounting that an invoice-only approach for this pilot is acceptable — they just need the signed addendum and a clear billing contact.

One quick clarification: can Redwood provide a payment remittance address and the name/email to send invoices to? Our AP system requires that so we can route invoices correctly.

Thanks — Claire
attachments: atlas-evidence-checklist-complete.pdf (application/pdf); atlas-w9.pdf (application/pdf)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Claire Hsu <claire@atlasinsights.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 13:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off no-PO onboarding for 3-week pilot

Kimberly / Claire —

Reviewed the checklist and W-9. Atlas Insights is low risk by our intake criteria (no red flags on SLR, standard insurance information provided). Procurement approves a temporary no-PO onboarding for this pilot under the following guardrails:
- Coverage period: 2026-08-09 through 2026-08-30
- Spend cap: $2,500 total
- Required addendum: billing to be invoice-only, invoices to be sent to billing@redwood-invoice.com with reference to DL-2026-089
- Evidence retained in vendor file; no recurring no-PO allowance beyond the pilot unless a full vendor onboarding completes

Kimberly — please have Marissa draft the addendum and Claire sign. Once signed, Accounting will accept invoices per the remittance instructions above.

David Kim
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire@atlasinsights.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off no-PO onboarding for 3-week pilot

Claire —

Thanks — attaching the draft one-off addendum for signature. Key commercial points mirror David's guardrails (pilot dates and $2,500 cap). Please review, sign via DocuSign and return; I'll countersign and route to Accounting so you can send your first invoice after provisioning.

I also included a very short invoicing guide (where to put reference DL-2026-089, tax info field, contact for payment queries). If you prefer a phone call to go over the addendum quickly, I'm available tomorrow morning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: one-off-no-po-addendum.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document); invoice-guide.txt (text/plain)
